The function f is defined by f : x 10 − (x − 3)2 for 2 ≤ x ≤ 7.
Find the range of f.
Range of f:
Dyna Thinking Coach
Bridge
connect to everyday life
Think of a ball thrown upwards: it rises to a highest point, then falls. 10 − (x − 3)2 behaves the same way, a hill, not a valley.
Slicer
break it into small parts
Step 1: find the top of the hill (when is the square 0?). Step 2: work out the outputs at x = 2 and at x = 7. Which end goes lower?
YOUR TURN
Write the range from the lowest output to the highest.

Find the range of f.
Range of f:

Vault

√ means the non-negative square root, so the root part is never below 0.
Translator
turn words into numbers, pictures or steps
Make a table: x = 2, 3, 6, 11. Watch how the outputs grow.
YOUR TURN
Find the smallest output. Does the output have a largest value? Write the range.
